name: number-ticker
title: Number Ticker
description: Counts a number up or down with a soft ease once it scrolls into view. Screen readers get the final value.

props.name: value
props.description: The number to count to (or from, when direction is "down").

props.name: startValue
props.description: The number the count starts at.

props.name: direction
props.description: Count up to value, or down from value to startValue.

props.name: delay
props.description: Seconds to wait once the number is in view.

props.name: locale
props.description: BCP 47 locale used to format the number.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Skips the count and shows the final number.

props.name: className
props.description: Extra classes for the root element.
